_source: Copied from bina-start-school/config/calendar-2026-27.json (transcribed 2026-09-14 from the printed 2026/27 bina calendar) + config/enrollment.json. Provisional: replace with the school team's final list when it lands.
_openQuestions: PROVISIONAL DATES (Akis, 2026-10-05): the school team is preparing the final start-date list. Until then the page is noindex and the start dates are computed from the rules below.

Rolling enrollment is under review: Ian (2026-10-02, group DM) asked for 'very strict rules … for example 1-2 dates within a biome'. If that wins, replace the computed Wednesdays with an explicit list in startDates.override.

Sign-by deadline: Juli (2026-10-04/05) says the cutoff for a Wednesday start is the Friday before (3 business days to onboard), and the cutoff for the Mon 5 Oct biome start was midnight Tuesday 29 Sep. bina-start-school/config/enrollment.json still says cutoffDays 6 (Thursday). This page follows Juli; reconcile the two.
Biome start Mondays are shown as start dates (Samuel 2026-09-28, Tica 2026-09-08: families start on the biome's first day). The rolling rules in Slack only talk about Wednesdays — confirm both count.
Wed 10 Mar 2027 non-school day inside Rainforest: 'still being confirmed with the school' (Akis quick guide, 2026-09-15).

nonSchoolDays.note: No-school day inside Rainforest (uncoloured on the printed calendar).

startDates._rules: Slack #strategy 2026-09-14 (confirmed by Juli) and #admissions-team 2026-09-15. A Wednesday is a start date only if: 1) inside a biome (no breaks), 2) not a non-school day, 3) not the biome's last day, 4) not the last remaining Wednesday of the biome. Plus each biome's first day (a Monday).
startDates._signBy: Wednesday start → sign by the Friday before (Juli, 2026-10-04). Monday biome start → sign by the Tuesday before (Juli, 2026-09-30, for Mon 5 Oct).
